home.heroSubtitle: A firm of excellence dedicated to international companies
home.home1: WEIL & ASSOCIES is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies since 1974.<nl/>Our firm is dedicated to assisting international companies,  small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defense of our clients before the courts and arbitral tribunals.<nl/>We think further, We work Smarter & We act Swiftly. <nl/> We represent & advise clients on a domestic and international level from corporate and commercial transactions including mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, technology transfers, litigation & arbitration, White collar crime, employment and labor law, to corporate governance & law. Our team of about twenty people, focuses exclusively on your business needs to bring you excellent services & solutions in a more efficient & sustainable way.
home.home2: Our firm is a member of an international network of law firms sharing its culture of excellence and efficiency. Our lawyers are also admitted to practice before foreign bars, including Germany or the New York Bar in the United States. <nl/>In addition to French and English, the team also works in German, making the firm a high-level partner with expertise in cross-border business relations between France and Germany.

expertise.ourGoal: <bold>Our goal is very simple:</bold> To provide successful businesses, individuals and entrepreneurs with high-level tailored services to solve their problems. The law is constantly evolving, along with related developments in your industry and the larger economy, may affect you and your business. That’s why we are making a point to always go further work smarter and always act swiftly with your best interest in mind and greatest attention to detail.
expertise.droitNumerique: IP/IT, digital, tech and data law

partenaire.teamPresentation: Our firm is made up of four experienced partners with <bold>over 100 years'combined professional experience</bold>. Each of them is fluent in English and German, and has an international legal profile and background. In addition to their specialist areas of expertise, each of our partners has a broad knowledge of business law, covering between them the full range of our clients'activities and needs.<nl/>You will find below an individual presentation of each partner. We also have a team of senior associates and lawyers, all of whom have legal training or international experience.

brunoWeil.intro: Active for twenty-five years as a lawyer for international companies of all sizes, present or active in France, Bruno Weil is your privileged contact within our firm for any question relating to intellectual property, digital, tech and data law, his preferred field. In this capacity, he acts as counsel or advocate before the courts in all types of contentious cases. As counsel he has successfully represented several major US and German listed companies before the French courts, notably in complex patent trademark and copyright infringement cases. A former French correspondent for the publisher KLUWER LAW INTERNATIONAL, he is also a member of several international associations dealing with intellectual property and new technologies, such as the Licensing Executive Society - LES - Germany, GRUR and ITECHLAW. Bruno Weil is also active in other fields, such as corporate restructuring and takeovers. His day-to-day practice also involves all types of business-related litigation. His main aim is to successfully devise the most effective business strategy to ensure that our clients'interests prevail. In addition to French, he is fluent in German and English. An amateur drummer and percussionist, he is the father of three children.

whoWeAre.firmPresentation: Since its establishment in 1974 WEIL & ASSOCIES is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies.<nl/>Our firm is devoted to assist companies, international or small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defence of our clients before courts and arbitral tribunals.
whoWeAre.NOUS SOMMES DEDIES A VOTRE SUCCES: WE ARE DEDICATED TO YOUR SUCCESS
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-dedies-a-votre-succes-descri: Since its establishment in 1974 WEIL & ASSOCIES is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies. Our firm is devoted to assist companies, international or small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defence of our clients before courts and arbitral tribunals.
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-internationnaux-description: Business relationships of German and English speaking countries have always been a major part of our activity. Therefore, our firm has lawyers admitted at bars in France, Germany and the USA at the same time. Our involvement in the advice to and representation of international clients implies that all lawyers write and speak fluently German, French and English. In the course of time, our activity conducted us to broaden our horizon and to represent companies from countries such as Japan, Korea and China.
whoWeAre.plus-loin-plus-intelligent-plus-rapide-d: Even though all lawyers are specialised, we believe in an enrichment of the juristic creativity by a large field of experience in legal advice and defence.
whoWeAre.votre-confiance-nous-honore-description: Our work is based on mutual trust with each and every client, international companies as well as small and medium-sized enterprises. Each client’s activity, products and professional environment are carefully taken into consideration as our goal is to provide our client with tailor made solutions which take due account of the client’s specific business interests. Thanks to the small size of our firm, we compose a team of dynamic lawyers who are acquainted to respond rapidly and with flexibility to the client’s needs. We shall never forget that the essence of our work, be it legal advice or advocacy, is to achieve an economically valuable result for our client.

contact.info-contact: Our offices are located at 26, Avenue de la Grande Armée, just a stone's throw from L'Etoile, in the centre of the business district. You can park your car just a few steps away in the public underground car parks on Avenue Carnot and Porte Maillot. ARGENTINE metro station (line 1) is nearby. Charles de Gaulle - Etoile RER station is a 5-minute walk away.
